plan.title: Confirm deletion of an RFP question

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation screen for the RFP setup.
Provide the required event title before configuring the RFP stage.
Create an RFP stage, which is the subject's questionnaire context.
Work on the RFP stage where the template question appears.
Apply an available RFP template containing the question.
Populate the RFP questionnaire so its question and controls are rendered.
Click the question's Delete control to initiate deletion; the control label is not explicitly cataloged for questionnaire questions.
Assert that a confirmation pop-up appears before deletion.
Confirm deletion in the confirmation pop-up.
Assert that the confirmation pop-up closes after confirmation.
